description: All eligible compact logs/JSON/reports/screenshots/probes and source/closure manifests. Complete source mirrors, dependencies, browser profiles, runtime environments/barriers are excluded. Raw traces remain external with hashes. Compact omissions only remove redundant passing screenshots. Failed evidence is preserved unchanged.
